decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-up today (NASDAQ +0.2%, S&P500 +0.4%), a neutral session with no strong directional catalyst. With cash above the deployment threshold and two open position slots, we added two well-confirmed momentum names (SLS, AGNC) while leaving one slot and cash reserve for a stronger risk-on setup, consistent with existing positions being held through the quiet session.

market_education.summary_en: Today's trading was muted, with the NASDAQ up just 0.2% and the S&P 500 up 0.4%, reflecting a lack of major economic data or corporate catalysts to move markets decisively in either direction. Investors appear to be consolidating recent gains rather than making large new directional bets. Without clear news-driven momentum, price action was largely range-bound across most sectors.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現平淡，納指僅升0.2%，標普500則升0.4%，反映市場缺乏重大經濟數據或企業消息刺激，未能形成明顯方向。投資者似乎在鞏固近期升幅，而非積極加碼新倉。由於缺乏新聞主導的動力，大部分板塊價格維持區間窄幅波動。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confirmation means only acting on a trade idea when multiple independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, and price relative to its moving average — all point the same direction at once. This reduces the chance of chasing a false signal from a single noisy indicator, and today's buys were chosen because they showed this kind of agreement without being overbought.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立技術指標（例如RSI、MACD及股價相對於移動平均線的位置）同時指向同一方向時，才採取交易行動。這樣可以減少單一指標出現噪音訊號而誤判的機會，今日所選的買入標的正是因為同時符合多項確認條件，且未達超買水平。
